sources.snippet: AIG Model Matching for MSFS 2024 Introduction This package provides the latest version of the Alpha India Group (AIG) AI traffic models for MSFS 2024. It makes installation quick and easy by removing the need for the AIG installer. This pack is for use with VATSIM but may work with offline traffic (more details below).
